problem: Operators accepting subcontracted monitoring installations need evidence that equipment is placed correctly, responds to physical tests, and meets the declared software policy.
solution: A deterministic local station binds an approved work order, camera measurements, signed device-test protocols, a useful paid inspector report, and a software-policy gate. The current demonstration preserves a real camera rejection and actual inspector payment. It does not establish complete physical acceptance.
currentImplementation: Actual Seeker camera evidence returned REWORK for incorrect placement. An independent inspector reviewed that exact camera evidence, returned a useful FAIL report, and received 1 test USDM on Cardano Preprod. Escrow, result, withdrawal, and positive seller collection verified. A separate earlier paid REVIEW used synthetic input and remains labeled. An ESP32 signed 18-second diagnostic and 72 recorded optical symbols verified separately. No complete fresh work-order-bound optical commissioning capture or button test exists. Two genuine paid NVD requests settled. The original deployed Base Sepolia replay and four tamper rejections pass. API3 is NOT QUALIFIED under the source-dependence requirement because a failed inspection prerequisite forces REJECTED regardless of the authenticated CVE verdict. The application is deterministic and operator-driven. It does not run autonomous LLM reasoning. A read-only phone viewer presents saved real evidence offline after one load. Actual installation and offline reload on the Seeker remain unverified.

whySignedDataMatters: A forged or substituted vulnerability response can misstate software acceptance. The contract checks the configured Airnode, exact CVE request and source age. NVD signatures do not identify firmware installed on a physical device.
businessCase: Hypothesis: an integrator accepting remote monitoring installations pays for a reproducible specialist report and fewer ambiguous handovers. Customer demand, pricing and reduced revisits remain unvalidated.
